issues.title: Late old-graph async completion can poison the active new-graph derived cache
issues.rootCause: The hook wrote a completed async value through an ambient cache API whose destination key was derived from the cache's mutable activeGraphVersion. It did not validate the request-producing graph identity or version.
issues.resolution: The cache now exposes only setCompleteForGraph for asynchronous completion. It requires Object.is equality for both graphVersion and graphIdentity before accepting a complete value. The hook supplies the producing request context, while coordinator cancellation and stale rejection remain independent.

issues.title: Asynchronous analytical work must be cancellable and stale-safe
issues.resolution: The original coordinator boundary remains intact and the corrective adds an independent cache-context boundary. A stale completion is now prevented from becoming cacheable even in an interleaving where the old coordinator still legitimately reports completion.

externalGateObservation.detail: npm audit reports the same high-severity browserslist advisory in the pre-existing dev dependency tree; npm audit --omit=dev reports zero vulnerabilities. No dependency or lockfile change was authorized.
